purpose: Define command-type UserModules as explicit one-shot operation surfaces with validated inputs and bounded effects, never as persistent input streams or UI ownership.

topics.name: Command Module Boundary
topics.purpose: Define command-type UserModules as explicit one-shot operation surfaces with validated inputs and bounded effects, never as persistent input streams or UI ownership.

semantics.execution_rule: A command invocation is a discrete one-shot operation.
semantics.effect_rule: Effects occur only through the command's declared canonical operation semantics.
semantics.state_rule: Persistent state belongs to declared data owners, not to the command invocation identity.
semantics.stream_rule: Continuous input/listener behavior is not command-type semantics.
semantics.view_rule: Rendering/UI projection is not command ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Command existence/visibility does not grant invocation authority.

invariants.rule: Command, input, adapter and view module types have distinct effect boundaries: command is one-shot operation, input writes declared instance data, adapter mounts/translates symbols without owning them, and view is UI-only.

hard_gates.condition: command silently behaves as persistent input stream

references.purpose: Command invocation crosses normal dispatch boundary.
